name: angler
description: Tilt-to-fight fishing. Cast, wait for the bobber to dive, then reel while tilting the console against each run the fish makes. 24 species across a pond, a mountain river, a coral coast and the abyss, each with its own hours by the real clock and its own depth. Rods, reels, line and lures; a Fishdex of record sizes saved to NVS.
